mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.owner_id, c.type, c.title, c.content, c.status, c.reply_content, c.reply_by, c.reply_time, c.create_time, o.name AS ownerName, o.phone AS ownerPhone, r.room_no AS roomNo, b.name AS buildingName, u.real_name AS replyByName FROM t_complaint c LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON o.id = c.owner_id LEFT JOIN t_room r ON r.id = o.room_id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON b.id = r.building_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = c.reply_by

sql.if: AND (c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: ORDER BY FIELD(c.status, '待处理', '已回复'), c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_complaint c LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON o.id = c.owner_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_complaint (owner_id, type, title, content, status, create_time) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, '待处理', NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_complaint SET reply_content = #{replyContent}, reply_by = #{replyBy}, reply_time = NOW(), status = '已回复' WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_complaint WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT type AS type, COUNT(*) AS num FROM t_complaint GROUP BY type
